name: Kalitas
description: A vampire who learned the hard way that the Eldrazi work through allies.

relations.note: Drove him and his traitors from Malakir.
relations.quote: Drana struck back, retaking control of Malakir and driving Kalitas and his traitors away from the city.

pages_say.description: A vampire who with the Ghet tried to turn Malakir's vampires into Eldrazi thralls and was driven off by Drana.
A vampire who learned the hard way that the Eldrazi work through allies.
